products.name: ASRock B860 Rock WiFi 7
products.desc: ATX - LGA1851
products.longDesc: ASRock B860 Rock WiFi 7 is an ATX motherboard for Intel Core Ultra processors (Series 2) using the LGA1851 socket. It supports four DDR5 DIMMs with dual-channel memory up to 8666+ MT/s (OC), a PCIe 5.0 x16 graphics slot, one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, one PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot and two PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots. Networking includes Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth and 2.5Gb Ethernet. It also provides HDMI, front USB-C, multiple USB ports, four SATA ports, Dr.MOS power delivery and onboard RGB headers.

products.name: ASRock B860 Challenger WiFi
products.desc: ATX - LGA1851

It supports four DDR5 DIMMs up to 8666+ MT/s (OC), PCIe 5.0 x16 graphics, three M.2 sockets (one Gen5 and two Gen4), and four SATA 6Gb/s ports. Wireless connectivity includes Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, alongside 2.5Gb Ethernet. It also includes HDMI, USB Type-C, BIOS Flashback and a multi-phase power design.
